law_record.title: Stopping, standing or parking prohibited in specified places (1)(k)
law_record.text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Alongside or opposite any highway excavation or obstruction when stopping, standing or parking would obstruct traffic.

activation_conditions: a highway excavation or obstruction is present
the subject stops, stands or parks alongside or opposite it
exceptions: when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
in compliance with the directions of a police officer or an official traffic-control device
residue: 'would obstruct traffic' is a judgement element: a residual-width or delay bound must be declared
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: judged while the vehicle rests there and the obstruction persists
